pageDescription: Lists the largest files in a folder, from the minimum size you choose, up to 500 files. It reads names, sizes and dates only; nothing is deleted without confirmation.
idleDescription: File names, sizes and dates are read; contents are never opened.
checkListDetail: Files from {{min}}, largest first, up to 500.
checkReadDetail: Name, size, modification date and last access date. File contents are never opened.
checkSkipDetail: Symbolic links, folders below the chosen level and folders excluded here or in Settings.
scanCancelled: Search stopped: the results are partial.
confirmRecycleTitle_one: Move {{files}} file to the Recycle Bin ({{size}})?
confirmRecycleTitle_other: Move {{files}} files to the Recycle Bin ({{size}})?
confirmRecycleDesc: Before it is moved, each file is checked against the scan and skipped if it changed or is excluded. You can restore them from the Recycle Bin; the space is freed when you empty it.
confirmPermanentDesc: Before it is deleted, each file is checked against the scan and skipped if it changed or is excluded. This cannot be undone: the files do not go to the Recycle Bin.
deletingRecycle_one: Moving {{files}} file to the Recycle Bin
deletingRecycle_other: Moving {{files}} files to the Recycle Bin
deletingFacts: Each file is checked again before it is touched.
receiptRecycleTitle: Files moved to the Recycle Bin
receiptRecycleNote: restorable from the Recycle Bin; the space is freed when you empty it
receiptSkipped_one: {{skipped}} file skipped because it changed after the scan, is excluded or could not be accessed.
receiptSkipped_other: {{skipped}} files skipped because they changed after the scan, are excluded or could not be accessed.
deleteRecycleToast_one: {{files}} file moved to the Recycle Bin ({{size}})
deleteRecycleToast_other: {{files}} files moved to the Recycle Bin ({{size}})
